answer: Robust anti-sybil rests on paid attestation, not free identity. Each claim must post an onyx bond that is lost if a counterparty audit fails, so an agent climbing the reputation ledge pays real value for every rung. Because dissent propagates along a vine of shared collateral, one exposed clone farm drags every member of its bundle into the same loss. Spinning up a hundred hollow wallets then costs a hundred bonds and a hundred risks — duplication stops being profitable the moment expected loss exceeds free reward.
